decisionsTitle: Invitations by email: a place kept for a named person until a deadline, accepted through the form
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-02**, with the 21 November race full (150 places, a capped waiting list): «După ce rezolvăm, vreau să trimit „invitații speciale” pe email pentru membrii BVR, un fel de adaugă manual.» — and, a message later, «Dar vreau și pentru non-membrii.» The club wants to seat chosen people — members, partners, guests — by sending each a personal invitation, rather than asking them to fight the public form or having staff type their whole registration («Adaugă o înscriere», §33, which needs the person's request relayed and every field). He was told the design below and did not object; the dispatcher launched it with these defaults while he is away.

**Decision.** An Administrator invites named people to one event from its registrations list, section «Invitații» (`registrations/ui/InvitationsPanel.tsx`, `InviteForm.tsx`): members ticked from the members' zone accounts (§524; any role, with a search), and/or people typed one per line — the name, then the address (`parseInvitationLines`) — plus «Zile până expiră» (7 by default, 1 to 60), «Pe lista ascunsă (nu ocupă un loc)» (§643's `outside_capacity`: organizers, volunteers, pacemakers, invited runners who take none of the advertised places) and «Limba invitației» (Română / English, Română by default). Each person gets one email, `EVENT_INVITATION`, in the member account's language, else in the language of the participant the address already belongs to, else in «Limba invitației» (stored on the invitation's `locale`, read by the email and the link's page): the club, the event and its start, until when the place is kept, «Acceptă invitația», and «dacă nu te așteptai la acest email, ignoră-l». The link opens the event's own registration form, prefilled: the name, the address said back and locked, «Sunt membru» ticked for a member — and set by the press on the server whatever is posted, so an unticked box or a draft without JavaScript cannot leave `club_member_declared` unset (anybody typed answers it themselves); every other field, the consents (terms, privacy notice, fitness, the list, the offers) and the declaration stay the person's. The section lists every invitation — name, address, state (trimisă / acceptată → the registration / expirată / retrasă), deadline, who sent it — with «Retrimite» and «Retrage» on the open ones; the editor's «Înscrierile primite» says «invitații în așteptare: N» and links to the section.

**The data.** `event_invitations` (migration `0124`): the event, the address's participant, the name and the address as typed, the canonical address (§10.4), the language, the member's account, who sent it, `sent_at`, `expires_at`, `outside_capacity`, `supplementary_raise`, `accepted_at` + `accepted_registration_id`, `withdrawn_at` + who, `expired_at`, `resend_count`, `last_sent_at`. **The state is three stamps and the deadline, not a status column**: live = none stamped and `expires_at` ahead; the count compares `expires_at` on every read (§10.6), and the maintenance sweep writes `expired_at` afterwards for the backoffice, the link's page and the partial unique index (one open invitation per address per event). Enum values (migration `0125`, expand only): `email_message_type` + `EVENT_INVITATION`, `email_action_token_purpose` + `ACCEPT_INVITATION`.

**The link** (§12.8, BR-REQ-036-02). `email_action_tokens` gains a nullable `invitation_id`: an `ACCEPT_INVITATION` token is scoped to the invitation and to the participant of its address, with no registration — none exists yet. The CHECK that tied «no registration» to `MANAGE_PROFILE` now admits this purpose too (compared as text, so the migration names no enum value it adds), a second CHECK ties the purpose to the invitation, the participant-scope unique index leaves invitation tokens out, and a new partial unique index keeps one live link per invitation. **Choice: the address's participant row is written at the send** when the address was never seen, because a token needs one; an existing row is used as it is — an invitation never rewrites another person's stored name or language, verified or not; the retention's orphan sweep leaves a participant with an invitation alone, and an ended invitation's deletion takes the row with it when nothing else holds it. The token is minted at the send (`notifications/invitation-render.ts`), hashed at rest; it lives until the invitation's deadline plus thirty days, so the page can say why it no longer works; whether it may still register is the invitation's own state, asked under the event lock. The GET (`/[locale]/registrations/invitation/[token]`) only reads (read-only transaction): the form, or «folosită», «retrasă», «expirată», «evenimentul a fost anulat», «există un email mai nou» (§619) or the generic refusal, each with the contact page.

**Accepting.** The press (`registrations/invitations.ts#acceptInvitation`) locks the event, asks the invitation again — open and before its deadline, the event scheduled and not started — and only then spends the token (single use, one UPDATE), and creates the registration through the one door, `submitRegistration`, with an origin `invitation`: the address is the invitation's whatever is posted; no anti-bot check, no full-line refusal, no family flow (one person per invitation, the staff entry's name rule `via: "staff"` — this runner again on the address is refused, anybody else within the club's limit); the public window's opening and the members-only door are not asked (the invitation is the door; the event must still be local, scheduled, dated and published); and **no verification email** — the link proved the inbox, so `seatInvitedRegistration` writes the participant's own `email_verified_at`, copies «În afara locurilor» from the invitation, and asks the one allocator for the place with the invitation's flag (`allocateOrWaitlist`'s `invited`, like a family's reserved place; its declaration hold capped by the start alone, never the close — the club may invite after it, and the close is the public door's, as for «Dă-i un loc acum»'s place): the registration becomes `PENDING_DECLARATION` with the ordinary deadline (§104) and its `COMPLETE_DECLARATION` email, **while the invitation still counts**, and only then is the invitation marked accepted — the place moves from the invitation's bucket to the hold in one transaction, with no instant where it is free. A refused form (a field, the terms changed, this runner on the address) rolls the token's spend back with everything else: the same link still works. Audited `event.invitation_accepted` (no actor).

**The formula** (`AGENTS.md` §10.6). `countOccupied` gains `invitationHolds`: live invitations, not «În afara locurilor», before their deadline; `computeOccupied` adds them, so the public line, `publicFill`, the free places, the queue panel and §589's sentence («… invitați {invited}») see them as taken; «Cine vine (N)» is unchanged — nobody is confirmed yet. **Why the club's choice**: like a family's reservation (§543), an invitation is never released for somebody waiting before its deadline — the club named this person and told them until when — only at the deadline (`expireStaleHolds` → `expireLapsedInvitations`, which every capacity-changing transaction runs first; the maintenance job selects an event with a lapsed one and is woken for the nearest deadline) or at «Retrage»; either way the place goes to the line as the event's setting says (`fillAvailableSpots`). `kind` is in no condition.

**Sending** (`service.ts#inviteToEventByStaff`, through `admin-service.ts#inviteToEvent`, the action `invitation-actions.ts#inviteAction`). The Administrator's alone, asserted in all three. One transaction for the whole list under the event lock: the event local, scheduled, published, dated and not started — **neither end of the public window is asked**: the club invites before the public opening and after the close, which is when organizers, pacemakers and volunteers are mostly invited, as «Trimite-i oferta» offers after the close (§642); the line served first (`fillAvailableSpots`, as `placeForNewcomer`); each address canonicalized and refused, **by the person's name, nothing written**, when it already holds a registration in a live state, an open invitation, or appears twice; the deadline `min(now + days, start)`. **On a full race, or while anybody waits (§642)** each invitation that needs a counted place and finds none free for it — free meaning free after everyone eligible who waits (`invitationFreePlaces`: `max(capacity − occupied − eligible WAITLISTED, 0)`) — adds one supplementary place (`addOneSupplementaryPlace`, audited `event.capacity_raised_for_invitation` with the invitation's id) — only when the form carried exactly the locked capacity plus that number (`invitationRaises`, `confirmsInvitationRaises`), which the dialog names before the press: «{n} invitații. Locuri libere pentru invitații acum: {free} — cine așteaptă pe listă are întâietate. Se adaugă {k} locuri suplimentare: capacitatea devine {cap}. Invitația expiră în {d} zile, cel mult la start. Limba pentru adresele pe care clubul nu le cunoaște: {limba}.», the button «Adaugă {k} locuri și trimite», or «Niciun loc nou». Any other number refuses the whole send with `SUPPLEMENTARY_PLACE_UNCONFIRMED`. An invitation never takes a lapsed declaration hold's place (§160): that runner may still sign, and the club's addition is the visible one. **«Pe lista ascunsă» (§643)** at the send: the invitations hold no counted place and need none, and the registration the link creates is outside the places too. Only on an event whose «Folosește lista ascunsă» is on (the hidden list's own switch, migration `0126`, off by default), as the registration page's radio: off, the form draws no tick and the send is refused under the event lock with `HIDDEN_LIST_OFF` — the registration page's own sentence, «Lista ascunsă e oprită la acest eveniment. Bifează întâi «Folosește lista ascunsă» în setările evenimentului.» — before anything is written or anybody emailed (the batch review of 2026-10-03). Audited `event.invitation_sent` by the invitation's id (deadline, outside, whether a place was added) — never the name or the address.

**Resend and withdraw.** «Retrimite» (`resendInvitationByStaff`): a new email and link — the old link superseded (§619) — the deadline kept, or moved to the days typed from now when that is later (never earlier) — the box is empty by default, and the dialog says which of the two the press does, `resend_count + 1`, audited. **Never later while anyone eligible waits** for an invitation that holds a counted place: then the link and the email are re-issued and the deadline kept (see the review of 2026-10-03, second round, below); one «Pe lista ascunsă» may be extended whoever waits. «Retrage» (`withdrawInvitationByStaff`): withdrawn now, the place offered to the line in the same transaction, audited; the link's page says withdrawn. Both under the event lock, both refused on an invitation no longer open.

**Privacy and retention.** The privacy notice's template (both languages, section 2) gains one paragraph under `{{eventInvitations}}` — filled with the section's own name, «Invitații»: an Administrator may enter a person's name and address to send one invitation, legitimate interest (art. 6(1)(f)); kept until accepted, withdrawn or expired, then as the registration's data or deleted like an unconfirmed registration (section 7). `/admin/tasks` carries the row `invitationsNotice` (open, never blocking) until a notice naming it is in force in every language; **the flow is allowed meanwhile**, as §389's registering of another person on one's own address was. The email carries its own privacy line («… ți-a trecut numele și adresa ca să te invite»). The retention job (`jobs/retention.ts`, step `invitations`) deletes an invitation that ended unaccepted — withdrawn, or past its deadline whether stamped or not (a cancelled event's are never swept) — thirty days after it ended (the window of an unconfirmed registration), with its link, then the orphaned participant; an accepted one goes with its registration.

**Refused.** A registration created by staff without the person — the declaration and the consents are theirs, and «Adaugă o înscriere» already exists for a relayed request. A public invitation code — anybody could pass it on, and it would name nobody. An invitation that bypasses the capacity without a confirmed place — overbooking by another name (BR-REQ-034-01). The address from a query string — the link carries only the token. A status column — a deadline is evaluated on every read, and a column the sweep forgot would keep a place nobody holds. Taking a lapsed declaration hold for an invitation — see above. Emailing the invitee when the invitation expires — the email said the deadline.

**Not done, recorded as follow-ups.** The automatic emails' forecast (§516) does not foresee the offer an invitation's lapse makes to the line.

**The review of 2026-10-02: an invited address registered another way takes the invitation over.** Before it, nothing joined an open invitation to a registration of the same address made by another route: an invitee who used the public form — or whom staff entered with «Adaugă o înscriere» — could sit on the waiting list of a full race behind a place held in their own name, the link then refusing them, and the club lost that place until the deadline unless somebody pressed «Retrage». Now, inside the locked transaction where a registration of that address gets its place by any route but the link — the allocator (`allocateOrWaitlist`: the public form's confirmation, a restart, a staff entry, the desk's paper confirmation, a late signature) and «Dă-i un loc acum» (`givePlaceNowByStaff`) — the address's open invitation before its deadline (`findLiveInvitationOfParticipant`) is **taken over**: the place is the registration's directly, as a family's reserved one is, never a waiting-list place and never a supplementary one; the invitation's hidden-list mark comes with it; and the invitation is stamped accepted with that registration's id after the transition, audited `event.invitation_accepted` with `adopted: true`, so the place moves from the invitation's bucket to the hold with no instant where it is free. A place the registration did not need (it was on the hidden list, held a family's reservation, or found one free anyway) goes to the line in the same transaction (`fillAvailableSpots`, a no-op on «Nu»). Never for a row in the line (`WAITLISTED`, `WAITLIST_OFFERED`), whose place comes as an offer. **By the address, not the name**: the invitation is the address's — one open per address per event, refused at the send while the address holds a registration, its link registering whoever the inbox names — so the first registration of that address to reach a place is the one the club kept it for. Typing the address on the public form takes nothing over by itself: a new registration on an address never confirmed waits for its confirmation email, and the invitation keeps the place until the inbox answers. A restart of an ended registration on an address already verified is seated at once, as before (§151), and so takes the invitation over on that press. The link's page then says «folosită»; pressed while the other registration still waits for its address, it refuses as before and now tells the person to press the confirmation email's link, which seats them in the kept place. The registration's page says «Înscriere pe invitație — trimisă de {who}, {when}» for every role that reads it, whichever way the invitation was accepted; and «Dă-i un loc acum»'s question names no supplementary place for a row whose address an invitation holds.

**The review of 2026-10-03: a free place somebody waits for is never an invitation's.** The send served the line (`fillAvailableSpots`) and then gave each invitation any place below the capacity — but that first step offers nothing when automatic offers are off («Nu», §615) and nothing after the close even when they are on, so in either case an invitation took a free counted place ahead of rows already `WAITLISTED`, against `AGENTS.md` §15.11's rule that no staff-made allocation goes ahead of anyone waiting and §615's that newcomers queue while anybody waits. Now, under the lock, the places free for invitations are `max(capacity − occupied − countEligibleWaitlisted, 0)` whatever the setting or the close, both in `invitationRaises` and in the per-invitation check; each invitation that needs a counted place while anyone eligible waits needs one confirmed supplementary place, or the send is refused with `SUPPLEMENTARY_PLACE_UNCONFIRMED`. The waiting row keeps its free place, to be offered by hand («Trimite-i oferta») or by the next refill. The dialog's forecast (`invitationForecastFree`, read by `admin-service.ts#readInvitationForecast`) always subtracts the waiting, so it names the same raise; its sentence now says «Locuri libere pentru invitații acum: {free} — cine așteaptă pe listă are întâietate.» With offers on and before the close the count comes out the same as before: each place the first step offers is one fewer free and one fewer waiting.

**The same review: a refused send asks again on the server's numbers, in the language and with the days chosen.** A send refused with `SUPPLEMENTARY_PLACE_UNCONFIRMED` (or any refusal) is answered with state, not a redirect, so the page's capacity and free count stayed as drawn and the «Apasă din nou» press was refused again until a reload; the action now reads the forecast again after any refusal (`readInvitationForecast`, for the role that may send) and hands it back in the state, and `InviteForm` asks the next dialog on it (and on the page's numbers again once the page is redrawn with different ones). «Limba invitației» and «Zile până expiră» are controlled state like the ticks and the typed lines — React reset them after a refused send, so the corrected press could have gone in Romanian with seven days — and the dialog names both: «Invitația expiră în {d} zile, cel mult la start.» (counted one / few / other) and «Limba pentru adresele pe care clubul nu le cunoaște: {limba}.»; days out of range are refused in the island before the dialog, as on the server. Also: the link page's «already registered» sentence is under 200 characters in both languages; the editor's link reads «Invitații» for a role that only reads the section (the Organizer, §289) and «Trimite invitații» for the Administrator; SETUP says «none of the announced places» rather than one race's number; two stale schema comments (`expires_at`, `locale`) say what the code does.

**The review of 2026-10-03, second round: a refused press spends nothing.** `acceptInvitation` spent the token before it asked the invitation's state and the event's, then returned `{ ok: false }` — which commits — so a press after «Retrage», past the deadline before the sweep, or after the event was called off or started left the token spent with nobody registered; the action redirected with no marker, and the page's next read found the token `ALREADY_USED` and said «Invitația a fost deja folosită: înscrierea e făcută. Caută emailul cu declarația» to a person who had no registration. Now every check runs under the lock before `consumeActionToken`: the invitation read again (open, before its deadline, still the token's participant), the event scheduled and not started; only then is the token spent, and a token that does not match the invitation after the spend throws, rolling the spend back. A token the spend refuses (used, superseded since the peek) wrote nothing, so that refusal may commit. The action lands on the link's page with `refused=<kind>` (`withdrawn`, `expired`, `cancelled`, `accepted`, `replaced`, `used`, `invalid` — a closed list, `isRefusedKind`), and the page says the press's own answer without a second read or a second attempt charged (§39); anything else in the marker reads the link as before.

**The same round: «Retrimite» never holds a counted place longer while anyone waits.** A resend with days typed moved the deadline later — up to the start, again at every resend — with no regard for who waits: a waiting row queued behind the deadline it was told, and the place goes back «only at the deadline» (`AGENTS.md` §10.6); moving it kept a counted place ahead of everyone waiting, without the confirmed supplementary place a send in the same state needs. Now, under the lock, when the invitation holds a counted place (not «Pe lista ascunsă») and `countEligibleWaitlisted > 0`, the resend re-issues the link and the email (the old link superseded, `resend_count + 1`) and keeps the deadline; the service returns `kept: "waiting"`, the toast says «Invitație retrimisă, cu un link nou. Termenul a rămas cel de acum: cineva așteaptă pe lista de așteptare.», and the audit row carries `keptForWaiting`. Beforehand the row shows no days box while the page sees anyone waiting, and the dialog says «Termenul rămâne cel de acum: cineva așteaptă pe listă, iar dacă invitația nu e acceptată până atunci, locul trece la listă.» (`readInvitationForecast` now also returns `waiting`). An invitation on the hidden list holds no counted place and may still be extended. The rule is in `AGENTS.md` §10.6 and §15.11 verb 7 and in SETUP; the rules table of CLAUDE.md and BUSINESS.md's invitation bullet now say the supplementary place is needed «on a full race, or while anyone waits».

**The review of 2026-10-03, third round: a called-off event says so.** The press and the GET both answered an event no longer `SCHEDULED` with `expired`, so the page said «Termenul invitației a trecut, iar locul păstrat s-a eliberat.» — a false reason: the deadline the email gave is usually still ahead, and cancelling an event leaves `event_invitations` as it was, so this page is the only thing that tells the invitee. Now both return a kind of their own, `cancelled` (in `REFUSED_KINDS`, so the press's `refused=cancelled` marker is said without a second read), and the page says «Evenimentul a fost anulat, așa că invitația nu mai e valabilă.» / «The event was cancelled, so the invitation is no longer valid.», under the same title «Invitația nu mai e valabilă»; a race already started still says `expired` — the deadline is capped by the start, so it has passed. Also: the resend dialog's sentence while anyone waits says the place goes to the list only if the invitation is not accepted by then («Termenul rămâne cel de acum: cineva așteaptă pe listă, iar dacă invitația nu e acceptată până atunci, locul trece la listă.»), and SETUP says the same; CLAUDE.md's overbooking row says a live invitation holds a counted place «unless sent «Pe lista ascunsă»»; and the resend criterion is filed under BR-REQ-037-07, the verb's requirement, rather than the capacity's.

**Tests.** `tests/integration/registrations/invitations.test.ts` (new): the held place in the count and the public line from the send, the member's account read, the deadline capped by the start and never by the close, a send after the close and its registration's hold capped by the start alone, «Limba invitației» for an address never seen and a known participant's language kept with its name and language untouched, the hidden list; the full race — unconfirmed or wrongly named raises refused with nothing written, exactly the named places added and audited, a free place used first; a free place with somebody waiting — automatic offers off, and after the close with offers on — refused unconfirmed and then invited on a supplementary place with the waiting row still waiting, and nobody waiting — offers off and after the close — no raise; the refusals by name, a cancelled or started event, and the Organizer; the link — the GET reads and leaves the token unspent, the secret nowhere at rest, the press seats the registration with the place moved and nobody offered, `event.invitation_accepted` by the ids alone, no verification email, single use, a refused form leaving the link working, an invitation on the hidden list, a member's link that presets «Sunt membru» and a press that sets it whatever is posted, a typed person's box left as posted; the take-over — the public form's confirmation on a full race seated in the invitation's place with nobody offered and the link then «used», a hidden-list invitation taken over, a place free anyway, «Dă-i un loc acum» adding no place; expiry with automatic offers (the job woken, the stamp, the line offered) and without (the place free, nobody offered), resend (old link «replaced», the deadline later never earlier, an empty box keeping it; with days typed on a counted invitation while somebody waits the link and the email again with the deadline kept, audited `keptForWaiting`, and the waiting row offered at that deadline; nobody waiting, the deadline moved; a hidden-list invitation moved while somebody waits) and withdraw (with and without automatic offers, the link «withdrawn»); a press after «Retrage», past the deadline before the sweep, and after the event was called off — each refused with the token unspent and the link's page then saying withdrawn, expired or cancelled, never «used»; the GET of a called-off event's link saying cancelled while the deadline is still ahead; a press after the start refused as expired — the start moved earlier after the send, so the invitation is still open at the press and only the start refuses it; an event marked «Încheiat» (COMPLETED) with its start ahead read and pressed as expired, never cancelled; the retention. `tests/integration/registrations/invitation-send-action.test.ts` (new): the send action refused on the page's stale numbers returns the server's forecast (capacity, free, waiting) and the second press, asked on it, is sent with the raised capacity; a refused duplicate line carries the forecast too; and the link's form pressed after «Retrage» lands on the page with `refused=withdrawn`, the token unspent. `tests/e2e/invitation-link.spec.ts` (new): the link at 320 px and on the desktop — the banner, the name and the address said back, nothing scrolling sideways, the press, the done view, the registration waiting for its declaration, the same link «used»; and the page's «cancelled» branch, drawn from the press's `refused=cancelled` marker — `invitation-cancelled` with «Evenimentul a fost anulat, așa că invitația nu mai e valabilă.» under «Invitația nu mai e valabilă», no form, nothing scrolling sideways (the featured race is shared by every spec, so it is never cancelled there; the read of a called-off event's link is asserted by kind in the integration suite). `tests/concurrency/capacity.test.ts`: two Administrators inviting onto the last free place on real connections — one invitation, one refusal, then exactly one place added on the confirmed press. `tests/unit/registrations/invitations.test.ts` (new; the waiting subtracted in `invitationRaises`, `invitationFreePlaces` and the forecast) and `tests/unit/diagnostics/owner-tasks.test.ts` (the row). Updated: the sentence of §589 (`give-place*.test.ts`), the message-type tables, the static routes, the density scale, the members-only callers, the notice's length ceiling.

**The review of 2026-10-03, fourth round: only a cancelled event says cancelled.** The third round answered every status other than `SCHEDULED` with `cancelled`; `event_status` also has `COMPLETED`, which the editor lets an Administrator set («Încheiat») while the start is still ahead, and nothing recaps an invitation's deadline when the start moves — so a still-open invitation on an event marked «Încheiat» would have told the invitee the event was cancelled. Now `readInvitationLink` and `acceptInvitation` say `cancelled` only for `eventStatus === "CANCELLED"`; `COMPLETED`, like a start already passed, says `expired`, and the token stays unspent. The page's refused sentences are a `Record<RefusedKind, key>` lookup (`INVITATION_SENTENCE_KEYS`) rather than a nested ternary.
changelogLine: - **Invitations by email** — an Administrator invites members, partners and guests to an event from its registrations list («Invitații»), before the public opening or after the close, until the start: each gets one email, in their own language or the one chosen, whose link opens the registration form with their name and address filled in, and a place is kept for them until a deadline (7 days by default); an invitee who registers another way takes the kept place once their address is confirmed or a place is given; an invitation never takes a free place somebody on the waiting list is owed: on a full race, or while anyone waits, the send adds one supplementary place per invitation after a confirmation that names the new capacity, the deadline and the language; «Pe lista ascunsă» for organizers and volunteers on an event whose hidden list is switched on; «Retrimite» (which keeps a counted invitation's deadline while anyone waits) and «Retrage»; a link pressed after its invitation ended says why — withdrawn, past its deadline, or the event cancelled (only a cancelled one: an event marked «Încheiat» says the deadline passed) — and stays unspent; the registration's page says it came from an invitation; the privacy notice's template describes it. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: A live invitation by email that was not sent «În afara locurilor» counts as one occupied place from its send until its deadline, its acceptance or its withdrawal — compared with its deadline on every read — so the public free places and the places line drop by one per invitation, and «Cine vine» does not change (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Accepting an invitation seats the registration in the invitation's place under the event lock while the invitation still counts, then marks it accepted, so the occupied count never drops in between and nobody waiting is offered that place; on a full race a send adds one supplementary place per invitation that needs one only when the form named exactly the resulting capacity, and two Administrators inviting onto the last free place at once make one invitation and one refusal (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

An `ACCEPT_INVITATION` link is scoped to its invitation, hashed at rest and minted at the send; opening it reads in a read-only transaction and spends nothing; the form's press spends it once, a refused form takes the spend back, and a resend's newer link makes the older one read as replaced (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Only an Administrator sends, resends or withdraws invitations — asserted in the action, the admin service and the service; a send refuses, by the person's name and writing nothing, an address already registered at the event, one already invited, or a line twice; no invitation creates a registration: the invited person registers and signs themselves from the link (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The privacy notice's template names `{{eventInvitations}}` once in each language, in the paragraph that describes the invitations by email, and `/admin/tasks` shows the row `invitationsNotice` open, never blocking, until a notice naming it is in force in every language (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A registration of an invited address that gets its place by another route than the invitation's link — the confirmation of the public form, a restart, a staff entry, the desk, a late signature or «Dă-i un loc acum» — takes the address's open invitation over in the same locked transaction: the place is the registration's with no supplementary place and no instant where it is free, the invitation is marked accepted with that registration and audited with `adopted`, a place the registration did not need goes to the line, and nobody waits behind a place held in their own name (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

An invitation may be sent while the event is scheduled, published and not started, after the public close included, its deadline capped by the start; a typed address the club already knows is written to in its participant's language and its stored name and language are never changed, an address never seen in the language the Administrator chose; a member's invitation registers a club member whatever the form posts; and the registration's page says who sent the invitation it came from and when, for every staff role that reads it (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A send of invitations never takes a counted free place while anyone eligible waits: under the event lock the places free for invitations are the capacity less the occupied places less the `WAITLISTED` rows with no offer, whether automatic offers are on or off and before or after the registration close, so each invitation beyond them needs one confirmed supplementary place or the whole send is refused with nothing written, the waiting row keeps its place, and the dialog's forecast subtracts the same waiting (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A refused send of invitations hands the island the server's current capacity and places free for invitations, so the next press's dialog names the raise the server will accept without a reload; «Limba invitației» and «Zile până expiră» keep the Administrator's choice after a refusal, and the confirmation dialog names both before anything is sent (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The invitation link's press asks, under the event lock and before it spends the token, whether the invitation is still open and before its deadline and the event still scheduled and not started; refused, it spends nothing, lands on the link's page with the refusal (withdrawn, expired, cancelled), and the page then reads the same — never «already used» for a person who has no registration (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

«Retrimite» with days typed never moves the deadline of an invitation that holds a counted place while anyone eligible waits: under the event lock it re-issues the link and the email and keeps the deadline, the dialog says so before the press, the result says the deadline was kept and the audit row records it; an invitation «Pe lista ascunsă», and one with nobody waiting, may still be moved later (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

An invitation's link to an event called off since the send (`CANCELLED`) — the GET and the press alike — says the event was cancelled («Evenimentul a fost anulat, așa că invitația nu mai e valabilă.»), never that the deadline passed; a race already started, or an event marked «Încheiat» (`COMPLETED`) even with its start ahead, says expired, never cancelled; the token stays unspent (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A send of invitations «Pe lista ascunsă» to an event whose «Folosește lista ascunsă» is off is refused under the event lock with `HIDDEN_LIST_OFF` — the registration page's own sentence — before any invitation is written or any email queued, and the invitation form draws the tick only while the switch is on; the same send goes through once the switch is on (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
